changelog:
DriveFight 0.20.26 — Jungle, tutorial, star power, and multiplayer refresh

- New Jungle biome, destructible plants and environmental art for offline play.
- Guided Easy Practice, a stronger invincibility star, and improved vehicle handling and weapon presentation.
- Ascending multi-kill rewards with warm, progressively rising notes.
- Updated main menu, HUD, downloads and installation guidance.
- Coordinated Mac, Windows and Linux dedicated-server release on protocol 13. All players must update.

Online play: Arena Battle and Soccer through the configured host/Tailscale network. Tower uses Arena Battle on Dust Pan with the current default rules. CTF, Easy Practice, Jungle and star mechanics retain their offline scope.

Validation: 1,956 EditMode tests; vehicle/combat parity; bot replication; network-condition scenarios; reconnect, match recovery and rendered smoke checks. Windows compiled successfully; Windows gameplay and public internet reachability have not been verified in this pass.

Free personal, noncommercial preview. Star music made with Suno. Mac and Windows builds are unsigned; see https://drivefight.vercel.app/ for installation steps.
